quantization: W-BFP4 / A-BiE4 G16 fake quantization with independent per-activation-tensor percentile-grid reconstruction-MSE thresholds
method_label: Activation-only BiE tensor-wise exact P95-P99 threshold grid search
format: W-BFP4 (1S3M + one E5, G16); A-BiE4 (1S3M + two E5 + per-value type bit, G16)

threshold_contract.applies_to: activation only; weights use single-exponent BFP
threshold_contract.exponent_mapping: float64 log2(exact FP16 percentile value); zero uses -128.0 sentinel
threshold_contract.selection: independent argmin activation tensor reconstruction MSE
threshold_contract.activation_granularity: one nn.Linear input tensor across all calibration calls
threshold_contract.threshold_storage: float64 log2 exponent per activation tensor

activation_block_outlier_profile.histogram_semantics: index k = G16 activation blocks with exactly k outlier values
